guided_advanced_description: Settings of this mod alone that the guided view's answers gave. They have no editor here.
guided_choice_allow_error: Write anyway, with what {code} says is lost
guided_choice_as_several_skins: Ship it as the skins it is made for
guided_choice_block_error: Do not write while {code} is found
guided_choice_cut_from_game_bank: Take the events from the game's bank only; sounds no event of it plays are left out
guided_choice_drop_stale: Leave them out: the game's newer files stand
guided_choice_keep_all_stale: Keep every one, as the mod's own files
guided_choice_keep_mod_bank: Take the events from the mod's own events bank
guided_choice_keep_other_slots: Ship the units at other skins too, each at its own skin
guided_choice_leave_to_game: Leave it to the game's own skin
guided_choice_one_skin: Ship one skin: leave the champion's other units to the game
guided_choice_takes_slot: {unit} takes skin {slot}, the others leave it
guided_kind_blocking_error_title: An error that refuses the write
guided_kind_events_bank_title: Where these sounds' events come from
guided_kind_several_skins_title: A mod made for several skins
guided_kind_slot_conflict_title: Units that tie on one skin
guided_kind_stale_files_title: Files that are the game's older bytes
guided_questions_description: The run made these choices by a default. Each is chosen as the run made it; change the ones the mod needs otherwise.
guided_start_description: Ports the mod with the standard settings as far as the plan, asks about each choice the run made by a default, and writes a .modpkg with the answers
